blocks.text: Banks borrow at one rate and lend at a higher one. The gap is the business.

questions.prompt: SoFi pays a depositor 4% on $10,000 and lends it out at 12%. What does it earn in a year?
questions.why: Earns $1,200 in interest, pays $400 to the depositor. The $800 left is net interest income, the core of a bank's profit.

questions.prompt: Now the deposit rate rises to 6%. What happens to that $800?
questions.why: SoFi now pays $600 instead of $400. When deposit rates rise faster than loan rates, the spread gets squeezed.
